comparison.objective: Fracture and recover installed-insert tangs; record seats a sleeve while registering its radial oil port.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate needs recessed coaxial tool alignment plus bimanual hammering; record needs orientation-preserving clearance-fit insertion and release.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, retained coils, and contained fragments; record requires seated/released stillness and an unobstructed 10 mm passage. Candidate fracture and damage tolerances are not quantified.
comparison.reason: The shared alignment primitive is generic; port registration through insertion tests a different central ability from impact fracture and debris handling.
